items.a: It means we have not yet confirmed that university's facts from its official website or a Ukrainian government register. It is not a judgement about the university. Until we have, our [directory](/universities/) shows only labelled leads from public sources (institution type, city, programme areas and a reported website), with no fees, programme details, dates or entry requirements.

items.q: Where do your fees and requirements come from?
items.a: Only from the university's official website, its published fee schedules and admissions documents, or Ukrainian government sources. A fact is shown as verified, with its source and the date we checked it, only after we have read it there.

items.q: Why are some facts marked “to be confirmed”?
items.a: Because we have not yet verified them from an official source, and we would rather show a gap than a guessed or outdated figure. If you need that fact now, ask us in your candidate profile and we will tell you whether we have been able to check it.
